`#Overflow(mode)`, the fixed-width overflow mode of one function, method or block body
`#MaxDepth(n)`, the recursion depth bound the stack bound counts
`#ContextKey`, a package's own key for the task context
`#Deadline(limit)`, the one way to bound the waits of a block or function body
`TypeId{T}`, a type the module sees written as a value where a `TypeId` is expected
`meta.find_type(text)`, a type lookup by its spelling on a `Compiler` value
`^name: value`, a changeable module global starting from a value computed while building
`#Pre(#run { … }, "…")`, a marker expression wrapped in `#run` whose answer is required while building
`#On(.Deep)`, the statement switch that turns on the deep checks of a block or function body
`compiler.query(source, kind, at:, limit:)`, the one typed fact query of Core's compiler library
a name in any script: letters, combining marks and digits by Unicode's default identifier rule, stored in one normal form
`\u{H}`, the escape naming one Unicode scalar by its hexadecimal value in quoted text and character literals
`Name<N: Int>: Bound #run { if … -> Type else -> Type }`, a type alias that chooses one of its bounded types while building
`if n % _ == 0 { 3 -> … else -> … }`, a hole table whose arms each fill the one `_` in the `if` header with a candidate
`#Encode`, `#Decode`, `#PublishedSchema`, `#CodableAsBase`, `#DenyUnknownFields`, `#Discriminant`, `#Untagged`, `#Skip` and `#Flatten`, now options on `#Codable`
`value.method` read without parentheses where a function type is expected, the method with its receiver bound
`#Waive(law, "reason")`, an impl's reasoned exemption from one law of its trait
`Set<T>{loop x in xs -> x}`, a typed set or map head holding one loop that builds its items
`#StepLimit(n)`, the compile-time step limit of one binding computed while building
`tag`, `effect`, `derive` and `pub` retired: a value tag is a marker struct, an effect or derive is an `impl` block beside its type, and a declaration is public unless `priv`
`#Input`, `#PII`, `#Secret` and `#Credential`, the four built-in value tags, now Prelude marker structs instead of declarations of the retired `tag` word
`#Runtime(.NoEager)` and `#Runtime(.Only)`, the run-time policy of one function, method or block body, which keeps its calls out of compile-time runs
`#Open`, the mark on a public enum that may gain cases, so a match from outside its package needs an `else` arm
`state { A -> B; Group: A | B }` / `Type.A`, the one state list of a struct or enum
`[T#N] / x.xyzw / x.swizzle(i, …)`, element-wise fixed-array arithmetic, letter swizzles and picking slots by number
`meta.stages()`, the ordered `compiler.Event` view of a build's program on a `Compiler` value
`impl [T].Trait / impl [T#N].Trait / impl T?.Trait / impl [K: V].Trait`, a structural impl head implementing a trait for every list, fixed array, optional or map
`Name: Grammar{"""…"""}`, the declaring grammar head: a module binding whose head is `core.grammar.Grammar` declares the types, `parse` and `print` of its rules
`#build.host.os` and `#build.host.arch`, the machine running the build, read beside the `#build.target.*` facts that name the machine the build is for
`#MoveOnly`, the mark on a type whose values move and never copy, so a package type states the fact a Core type states
